description: Tempo layer. The generator resolves an exact BPM inside the genre window, then labels the zone and picks a compatible groove feel, swing amount and time signature.

zones.name: Crawl
zones.note: Slow enough that every hit is an event.

zones.name: Slow
zones.note: Head-nod territory. Nothing needs to hurry.

zones.name: Classic
zones.note: The pocket most sample loops were born in.

zones.name: Mid
zones.note: Enough motion to dance, enough space to rap.

zones.name: Uptempo
zones.note: Half-time it if the melody needs air.

zones.name: Fast
zones.note: Hats carry the energy. Keep the melody simple.

zones.name: Hyper
zones.note: Write for the half-time listener, not the grid.

grooveFeels.name: Straight
grooveFeels.note: Dead on the grid. Let the samples create the wobble.

grooveFeels.name: Light Swing
grooveFeels.note: Barely there. You should feel it, not hear it.

grooveFeels.name: Heavy Swing
grooveFeels.note: Push it until it almost trips.

grooveFeels.name: Drunk Timing
grooveFeels.note: Nudge hits manually. No two bars identical.

grooveFeels.name: Behind The Beat
grooveFeels.note: Drag the snare 10-25ms late on purpose.

grooveFeels.name: Ahead Of The Beat
grooveFeels.note: Push the hats early. It should feel anxious.

grooveFeels.name: Half-Time Feel
grooveFeels.note: Snare on 3. Double the tempo, halve the drums.

grooveFeels.name: Double-Time Feel
grooveFeels.note: Keep the loop slow, run the percussion fast.

timeSignatures.note: Waltz the loop. Rap will have to adapt.
One extra beat per bar. Nobody will notice at first.
Loop will fight you. Win anyway.

quantizeModes.name: No Quantize
quantizeModes.note: Play it in. Keep the first take.

quantizeModes.name: Hard Quantize
quantizeModes.note: 100% grid. Let the samples do the swinging.

quantizeModes.name: 50% Quantize
quantizeModes.note: Halfway corrected. Keeps human error readable.

quantizeModes.name: Groove Template
quantizeModes.note: Extract the groove from the sample, apply to drums.

quantizeModes.name: Manual Nudge
quantizeModes.note: Drag every hit by ear. No tools.
